Latona Township is a civil township located in Walsh County, North Dakota. Here's what I can tell you about it:

## Location and Geography
- Located in Walsh County in northeastern North Dakota
- Walsh County borders Minnesota to the east and is near the Canadian border
- The township follows the standard township survey system used throughout much of North Dakota

## Administrative Details
- It's one of several townships that make up Walsh County's local government structure
- Like other North Dakota townships, it likely covers approximately 36 square miles (the standard township size)
- Falls under the broader jurisdiction of Walsh County government

## Regional Context
- Walsh County's county seat is Grafton
- The area is part of the Red River Valley region
- The economy of the broader region is primarily agricultural, focusing on crops like wheat, soybeans, corn, and sugar beets

## Demographics and Settlement
- Like many rural North Dakota townships, Latona Township likely has a small population
- The area would have been settled primarily in the late 19th/early 20th century during the major agricultural settlement period of North Dakota
